//: You normally do NOT write this file by hand -- run install.sh (Linux), install-macos.sh, or install-windows.ps1 and sign in with your Lumisound email/username + password. The installer exchanges those for the token below and never stores your password.
access_token: written for you by the installer; or paste one from Lumisound -> Account -> Discord Rich Presence -> Generate Rich Presence Token
//show_when_paused: Optional. Default false: while playback is paused, Rich Presence is cleared rather than leaving the track on screen. Set true to keep showing the paused track (without an elapsed timer).
//bridge_url: Optional. Only needed if you run your own ios-bridge instance; defaults to the hosted Lumisound bridge.
//username: Optional fallback instead of access_token: set username (or email) + password and the daemon will log in itself, swap them for a 365-day Rich Presence token, write it to access_token, and delete the password from this file. Accounts with 2FA cannot use this -- the daemon can't prompt for a code, so run an installer (which can) or paste a token.
//password: See //username above. Prefer the installers; this path exists for unattended/scripted setups.
